description: This file defines an abstract class for loan transaction business events within the Fineract project. It extends a generic business event class and provides category and aggregate root ID methods specific to loan transactions.

classes.name: LoanTransactionBusinessEvent
classes.description: An abstract base class for events related to loan transactions, categorizing events and providing access to the related loan transaction ID.

methods.name: LoanTransactionBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with a LoanTransaction object.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category string 'Loan' for this event type.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the loan associated with the transaction, serving as the aggregate root identifier.
